app.name: HillFinder
app.tagline: The best hill near you for hill repeats

location.permissionBody: Your browser will ask for permission. Your position is only used to search for hills around you; it isn't stored or shared.
location.denied: Location access was denied. Type an address instead.
location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location. Type an address instead.
location.error: Address search failed. Please try again.

filters.avoidTrafficHint: Prefer paths, parks and quiet streets

sourceHints.fast: Searches in seconds. No lighting info, fewer park names.
sourceHints.detailed: Full OpenStreetMap details incl. lighting. First search in an area can take a minute.

filters.includeStairsHint: Stair repeats: often the steepest thing in a flat city

status.slow: The first detailed search in an area can take a minute; it's cached afterwards.
status.busy: The OpenStreetMap servers are busy right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
status.empty: No climbs found in this area. Elevation data currently covers France only.
status.partial: Some elevation data couldn't be downloaded, so a few hills may be missing. Search again later to fill the gaps.
status.relaxed: Few hills match your filters here, so these are the best available.
status.nearby: Looking for hills close to you…
status.showingNearby: Showing hills within {{km}} km while the wider search finishes.
status.offline: You're offline. Your favourites still work; searching will resume when you're back online.
status.measuring: Re-measuring profiles with LiDAR HD (50 cm)…

session.title: Suggested session
session.detail: ≈ {{time}} per rep at hard effort, jog back down to recover. +{{gain}} m per rep, +{{total}} m total.
session.sectionWhere: Rep from {{from}} m to {{to}} m up the climb (shaded on the profile and map).
session.stepsEstimated: Step count estimated from the height (≈17 cm per step).

data.fast: Paths © OpenMapTiles via OpenFreeMap · © OpenStreetMap contributors · Elevation © IGN (RGE ALTI)
data.detailed: Paths © OpenStreetMap contributors (Overpass API) · Elevation © IGN (RGE ALTI)

access.title: Access
access.hours: In a park with opening hours: {{hours}}
access.noHoursCheck: Opening hours and gates aren't checked with fast data.
access.clear: No access restriction found on the map.
access.disclaimer: From OpenStreetMap: signs on site always take precedence.

favorites.note: Saved in this browser only. Distances are from your current search location.
favorites.empty: No favourites yet. Tap ☆ on a climb to keep it here, even offline.

accuracy.lidar: Profile measured with IGN LiDAR HD (50 cm).
accuracy.rge: Profile measured with IGN RGE ALTI (1–5 m); LiDAR HD isn't available here yet.
accuracy.coarse: Profile from the detection grid; it's re-measured when the climb is shown in the list.
accuracy.check: Check on site: this profile may be off.

reasons.mismatch: Fine and coarse measurements disagree, often a wall, embankment or cutting right next to the path.
reasons.roadTooSteep: That's unusually steep for a road.
reasons.osmIncline: OpenStreetMap says the slope is about {{incline}}%.
